mapper.select: SELECT p.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target t WHERE t.plan_id=p.plan_id) AS target_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target t WHERE t.plan_id=p.plan_id AND t.result_status='DONE') AS done_cnt FROM pmc_inspection_plan p ORDER BY p.plan_id DESC

SELECT p.*, (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target t WHERE t.plan_id=p.plan_id) AS target_cnt, (SELECT count(*) FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target t WHERE t.plan_id=p.plan_id AND t.result_status='DONE') AS done_cnt FROM pmc_inspection_plan p WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_inspection_plan(plan_name, cycle, period_from, period_to, policy_id, planned_date, inspector_id, approver_id, status, approve_status, reg_user) VALUES(#{planName}, #{cycle}, #{periodFrom}, #{periodTo}, #{policyId}, #{plannedDate}, #{inspectorId}, #{approverId}, 'PLANNED', 'NONE', 'admin')
INSERT INTO pmc_inspection_plan_target(plan_id, server_id, result_status) VALUES(#{planId}, #{serverId}, 'PENDING') ON CONFLICT (plan_id, server_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT t.*, s.hostname, s.os_type, s.service_name, r.overall_status FROM pmc_inspection_plan_target t JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=t.server_id LEFT JOIN pmc_inspection_run r ON r.run_id=t.run_id WHERE t.plan_id=#{planId} ORDER BY t.plan_target_id
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_inspection_plan SET status=#{status}, upd_dt=now() WHERE plan_id=#{planId}
UPDATE pmc_inspection_plan SET status='OVERDUE' WHERE status IN ('PLANNED','IN_PROGRESS') AND planned_date IS NOT NULL AND planned_date < now()::date
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(run_id AS varchar) FROM pmc_inspection_run WHERE server_id=#{serverId} ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1
